tapeLine: Tuesday 3 November: S&P 500 +0.36% to 7,568.92, ending a three-day losing streak, per TipRanks (3 Nov). Nasdaq and Dow closes and Wednesday futures were not found.
matters:
Chip stocks rebounded on US midterm election day: AMD, Intel and Micron each rose more than 2%, per reports dated 3 Nov. AMD then forecast faster-than-expected 2027 growth after the close and was up about 8% in extended trading.

Alphabet was weak, around 0.4% lower, and Apple closed nearly 2% lower after guiding to a slightly soft gross margin on memory-chip costs. Sources differ on breadth: Reuters said more S&P 500 stocks fell than rose.
